rv.q: It’s a script that leaves no loose end – every single line has a worthwhile, deliciously funny purpose.
Matt DiCarlo’s production hums with comedic harmony.
These actors know how to fail with a flourish.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre's latest delivers familiar but expertly executed slapstick chaos, with immaculately timed gags and a standout cast keeping the well-worn "goes wrong" formula fresh and delightfully entertaining despite some predictability.
